title: From a bound to the zeros
line: A one-sided bound on primes rules out zeros
summary: A weighted count of primes whose error “sees” the zeros, and why bounding that error from above is enough.
story: `Zeros/PrimeError` defines a weighted prime count and its remainder R_q. Its transform has poles exactly at zeros of L-functions, so the zeros show up as waves in the count of primes.

`Zeros/Criterion` turns a bound into a zero-free region. An eventual bound from above, R_q(x) ≤ A·x^(β−1), excludes zeros to the right of β. No lower bound is needed. Its notes cite Landau (1905) and Suzuki (2024).
`OneSidedBound` proves the bound with β = 1/2 + ε, using the main inequality (part 4) and the prime number theorem at a far-out second cut-off (`Zeros/PrimeNumberTheorem`), and ends with `grh`.

elsewhere.label: Tam Nguyen Duc: the window bound (original edition; matched by title)

modules.title: A weighted prime-counting error term and its poles at zeros of L-functions
modules.group: From a one-sided bound to the zeros
modules.note:
Let `d` be a prime and `χ_K = (·/d)` the Legendre symbol. We study the remainder `R_q` of a weighted
sum over the prime powers `n ≡ 1` modulo `q` with `χ_K(n) ≠ 1`. Its Laplace transform sees the zeros
of the Dirichlet `L`-functions modulo `q` and of their twists by `χ_K`.

* `New.lambdaKResidueClass`: the weight `λ(n) = Λ(n) (1 - χ_K(n))` on `n ≡ 1` modulo `q`; it is
  nonnegative.
* `New.logDerivMean`: the mean `G_q` over the characters `ψ` modulo `q` of the differences of the
  logarithmic derivatives of `New.entireL (New.quadTwist ψ d)` and `New.entireL ψ`, less `1 / φ(q)`.
* `New.primeRemainder`: `R_q(x) = ∑_{n ≤ x} λ(n) (1/n - 1/x) - log x / φ(q) - re G_q(1)`.
* `New.LSeries_lambdaKResidueClass_eq_add_logDerivMean`: for odd `d` prime to `q`, the Dirichlet
  series of `λ` is `s / (φ(q) (s - 1)) + G_q(s)` in `re s > 1`.
* `New.isPolar_primeRemainder`: for `d ≡ 7` modulo `8` prime to `q`, the transform of
  `v ↦ R_q(e ^ v)` has at most simple poles in `re s > 0`, none at `1`, and at `s ≠ 1` with the
  residue `(n(s) - n'(s)) / (φ(q) s (1 - s))`, where `n(s)` and `n'(s)` are the sums of the orders
  at `s` of these `L`-functions and of their twists.

Here `New.entireL ψ` is `L(s, ψ)`, times `s - 1` if `ψ` is principal, `New.quadTwist ψ d` is the
character `ψ χ_K`, and `New.chowlaSelbergConst d` is, for odd `d`, `γ - re L'/L(1, χ_K)`, with `γ`
Euler's constant.
modules.literature:
The transform of a weighted prime sum in a residue class is computed by orthogonality of characters
and partial summation. Source: Davenport, Multiplicative Number Theory.

modules.title: The one-sided criterion for a zero-free half-plane
modules.group: From a one-sided bound to the zeros
modules.note:
`New.LFunction_ne_zero_of_primeRemainder_le`: an eventual upper bound `R_q(x) ≤ A * x ^ (β - 1)` for the
remainder of a sum over prime powers `≡ 1` mod `q` with weights depending on a prime `d`, for all
`d` of a suitable class, excludes zeros `s ≠ 1` of the `L(s, ψ)`, `ψ` mod `q`, in `re s > β`.

Notions from other files:
* `primeRemainder d q x`: the remainder `R_q(x) = ∑_{n ≤ x} λ(n) (1/n - 1/x) - log x / φ(q) - c_q`,
  where `λ(n) = Λ(n) (1 - (n/d))` for `n ≡ 1` mod `q` and `0` otherwise, and `c_q` is a constant.
* `entireL ψ`: the entire function `L(s, ψ)`, times `s - 1` if `ψ` is principal.
* `quadTwist ψ d`: the product of `ψ` and the Legendre symbol `(·/d)`.
* `IsPolar E r`: the transform `∫₀^∞ E(v) e^{(1-s)v} dv` continues meromorphically, with at most
  simple poles in `re s > 0` and residues `r`.
modules.literature:
The hypotheses concern only the remainders, for all primes `d` of the class, and not the real zeros
of the `L(s, ψ)`. In the literature: a one-sided bound for a weighted sum over primes `≡ 1` modulo
`q` gives a zero-free half-plane if there are no real zeros. Related work: M. Suzuki, On variants of
Chebyshev's conjecture, arXiv 2411.07436, 2024; Montgomery–Vaughan, Multiplicative Number Theory I,
§15.1–15.2, 2007; Landau, Über einen Satz von Tschebyschef, 1905.
role: A one-sided bound gives a zero-free half-plane.

modules.title: The prime number theorem for the remainders `R_q`
modules.group: From a one-sided bound to the zeros
modules.note:
Let `d` be a prime and `q ≥ 1`. The remainder `R_q(y)` is an integral of the error `𝓔_q(t)` in the
weighted count (`primeRemainder_eq_integral_countError_sub`), so it varies slowly. For odd `d` prime
to `q` its absolute value is at most `(log y) ^ (-B)` for all large `y`, for every natural number
`B`; so it tends to `0`, which characterises the constant `c_q` in its definition.

Notions from other files:
* `lambdaKResidueClass d q n` is `λ(n) = Λ(n) (1 - (n/d))` for `n ≡ 1` mod `q`, and `0` for other
  `n`.
* `entireL ψ` is `L(s, ψ)`, multiplied by `s - 1` if `ψ` is principal; `quadTwist ψ d` is the
  product of `ψ` and the Legendre symbol `(·/d)`.
* `logDerivMean d q` is the function `G_q` that continues `∑ λ(n) n ^ (-s) - s / (φ(q) (s - 1))`
  when `d` is odd and prime to `q`.
* `primeRemainder d q y` is `R_q(y) = ∑_{n ≤ y} λ(n) (1/n - 1/y) - log y / φ(q) - c_q` with
  `c_q = re G_q(1)`.
modules.literature:
Known result: Prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions with an error term that saves every
power of the logarithm. It is a case of the Siegel–Walfisz theorem. Source: Montgomery and Vaughan,
Multiplicative Number Theory I, 2007, Cor. 11.19. Form here: the modulus is fixed, and the count is
the smoothed sum `∑_{n ≤ y} λ(n) (1/n - 1/y)` over the prime powers `n ≡ 1` mod `q`; for `d ≡ 3` mod
`4` the primes that split in `ℚ(√-d)` have weight zero.
role: The prime number theorem for the remainder of the prime sum, used at the second cut-off.

modules.title: The one-sided bound, and the theorem in half-plane form
modules.group: Three theorems and the main inequality
modules.note:
For admissible data at an integer `x`, the main inequality and the prime number theorem at a much
larger cut-off `x₁` give the bound `R_{q₀}(x) ≤ (128 φ(q₀) + 32) x ^ (-1/2 + ε)` for large `x`.
The one-sided criterion gives non-vanishing of Dirichlet `L`-functions in `re s > 1/2`.

Notions from other files:
* `Parameters`: a multiple `q₀ = P.q₀` of `18480` and a prime `d = P.d ≡ q₀ / 2 - 1` modulo `q₀`.
* `primeRemainder d q x`: the remainder `R_q(x) = ∑_{n ≤ x} λ(n) (1/n - 1/x) - log x / φ(q) - c_q`.
  Here `λ(n) = Λ(n) (1 - chiK d n)` for `n ≡ 1` modulo `q` and `0` otherwise, with `chiK d` the
  Legendre symbol modulo `d`; for odd `d` prime to `q`, `c_q` is the constant with `R_q(x) → 0`.
* `Data P`: admissible data, among them the scales `x`, `x₁`, `b`, `a = x b`, the number of lifts
  `m` and two finite sets of places of a number field, `Φ_a = D.aPlaces` and `Φ_b = D.bPlaces`.
role: The one-sided bound x^(−1/2 + ε) for the remainder of the prime sum.
No Dirichlet L-function vanishes in re s > 1/2 (s ≠ 1 for a principal character).
